The Concept

Sell Premium Himalayan Salt Under Your Own Brand

Private label Himalayan pink salt allows your business to sell premium salt products under your brand name without managing mining, processing, manufacturing or packaging directly. You choose the salt type, grain size, packaging format and branding elements - we handle the entire production process and quality control.

  • Ethically sourced, carefully processed Himalayan pink salt
  • Different colours and grain sizes for every market
  • GFSI-integrated, gluten-free and nut-free labeling facility

How It Works

From Mine to Market in 8 Steps

A simple, hassle-free route from first inquiry to international delivery.

1

Submit Your Inquiry

Share your product requirements, target market and estimated order quantity with our team.

2

Inquiry Review & Assistance

Our sales team evaluates your inquiry and guides you through the next steps with a prompt response.

3

Select Products & SKUs

Choose the Himalayan salt products, grain sizes and SKUs that best suit your brand and customers.

4

Choose Packaging & Customization

Select your preferred packaging format, product specifications and customization options.

5

Share Your Branding Requirements

Share your artwork and branding guidelines, or let our design team create a design for you.

6

Approve Samples & Artwork

Review and approve product samples and packaging designs before production begins.

7

Production & Quality Control

Your order is manufactured under strict quality control and international compliance standards.

8

International Shipping & Delivery

Your order is securely packed and shipped through reliable logistics to your destination.
